status: fixed before V7 fitting; exploratory development study after V1-V6 were viewed
question: Can two local experts add stable value when the common LSTM representation and prediction are learned first, frozen, and local residuals are fitted on later training dates?

fixed_primary_task.target: next SRT trading-day raw close log return
fixed_primary_task.architecture: LSTM32 -> tanh 3D -> two Gaussian rules -> two affine experts; shared/local form q@(b+d), q@(b-d)

chronology: For inner selection split the original outer train chronologically into first 85% fit and last 15% stop. Split that fit prefix into first 75% common-learning and last 25% expert-calibration. For outer refit split the full outer train 75% common-learning / 25% expert-calibration. Input and target scale, representation and common b use only common-learning labels and windows. The expert-calibration labels never train or select the common predictor. The same fitted encoder and 3D coordinates are used for both stages; no concatenated cross-fit latent coordinates.
stage_1: Train V5 linear HybridHead representation on common-learning prefix for exactly 10 full-batch epochs, differentiable ridge common penalty 0.1, AdamW lr 0.001 weight decay 0.0001 gradient clip 1. Recompute training-only latent normalization and solve common b on that same prefix. No stage-1 epoch search.
stage_2: Freeze encoder, projection, normalization and common b. Fit a four-coefficient affine difference d on later expert-calibration residuals with ridge penalty 1.0. Optimize only Gaussian centers and widths, or matched ordinary gate parameters, with full-batch AdamW lr 0.001, weight decay 0.0001 and gradient clip 1. Inspect epoch 0 through 40 on inner stop; select lowest stop MSE only if it improves the common-only predictor by at least 0.0001 in scaled MSE. Stop after 10 non-improving epochs. In outer refit restart with same seed and train the selected epoch count; if no accepted local stage, keep local term exactly zero.
attribution: The three V7 arms share the identical stage-1 model, data split, scaling and b within each fold/seed. Gaussian versus gate differs only in the stage-2 gate. Compare each to V7Common first; comparisons to V1/V5 are historical context because their training-data allocation differs.
budget: nine shared inner common fits plus nine shared outer common fits; 18 inner and 18 outer local-head fits. No scan over stage fractions, epoch cap, penalties or seeds.
candidate_gate: V7StagedGaussian mean seed-pooled RMSE at least 1% lower than both V7Common and Z0; at least two fold-mean wins vs each; at least six of nine fold-seed wins vs V7Common; pooled MAE at most 1% above Z0; nonzero local stage accepted in at least six of nine inner selections.
substantial_goal: at least 3% mean seed-pooled RMSE improvement versus strongest fixed same-information reference; development resource target, not a course rule or independent statistical claim
stopping: If candidate gate fails, do not advance this split-calibration variant to joint fine-tuning, alter the split after seeing results, or label a common-only/zero-local outcome as a fuzzy expert improvement.
outputs: development predictions, matched common/local components and expert diagnostics, per-fold/seed and pooled metrics, stage losses, chronology and source hashes; no final-period predictions
